label: Soup Pot
depicts: Cooking pot body with one spoon inside and two steam curls rising above the rim
use_when: Use when the interface wants the pot to read as active cooking with a spoon and steam visible.
avoid_when: Do not use for the lidded pot when the cookware should look closed with side handles and no spoon inside.

label: Soup Pot
depicts: Cooking pot with a fitted lid and two side handles around a wide rounded body
use_when: Use when the interface wants a closed pot silhouette without the spoon and steam of active stirring.
avoid_when: Do not use for the stirred soup pot when the cookware should not show a spoon rising from the open bowl.

label: Sparkles
depicts: One large diamond star with one smaller diamond star at the lower left
use_when: Use when the interface wants sparkles to read as a large diamond star paired with one smaller companion star.
avoid_when: Do not use for the sparkle variants with an extra dot accent or with a full ring of short rays around the center.

label: Sparkles
depicts: One large diamond star with one small diamond star and one small dot at the upper left
use_when: Use when the interface wants the sparkle group to include one extra dot accent beside the large and small stars.
avoid_when: Do not use for the plain two star sparkle or the central star with short rays around it.

label: Sparkles
depicts: Diamond star centered inside eight short rays around the outer rim
use_when: Use when the interface wants the sparkle to feel radiant with a full ring of short rays around the center star.
avoid_when: Do not use for the simpler sparkle pairs when the mark should not reduce to only two stars or two stars plus one dot.
